scene: The badger mechanic rolls open triple garage doors revealing three departing transit platforms.
picture: Flat side view through the workshop's broad open rear doorway. Far left stands a badger mechanic wiping greasy paws. Left of centre, the grandfather holds his bicycle with crate plants. Outside along one continuous platform line sit a mossy garden tram on the left, a red streetcar centre, and a bento train right.
shown: a mossy green garden tram on tracks waiting with doors open on the left
a clanging red retro streetcar idling on iron rails in the centre
a sleek bullet-nosed bento express railcar stopped at the platform on the right
